crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
“Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and…
For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be…
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…

translations.web: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
translations.bsb: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
translations.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do
translations.asv: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?
